reason: The premises on stochastic mixing and single-phase formation are well supported by E3 and E1, but the claims about isolated active sites, modulated d-band profiles, and a specific 2× activity enhancement lack any cited evidence.
premises: Dropwise injection creates a steady-state low concentration of each metal precursor
Low precursor concentration limits atomic mobility and enforces stochastic mixing
Stochastic mixing yields single-phase HEA nanoparticles more readily than binary alloys
Single-phase HEA nanoparticles contain isolated noble metal sites with modulated d-band electronic profiles
These HEA nanoparticles exhibit ~2× enhanced catalytic activity (ORR/HER) over binary alloys
